name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 写测试前先问这条断言值不值钱的 Laravel 评审
tagline_zh: 测试写完跑绿了不代表有用：它盯的是覆盖率选得对不对、测试名说不说得清失败原因、数据造得够不够小。
tagline_en: Green tests aren't the same as useful tests. It checks coverage choice, test naming, minimal fixtures, HTTP and.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 它按设计意图评审而不是按语法：先问这条测试在防哪种回归，再谈断言、数据与隔离。
why_en: Reviews by design intent, not syntax: first asks which regression a test guards, then assertions, data, isolation. Syntax.
limit_zh: 只管 Laravel 测试的设计与评审，不写业务代码、不替你跑测试、不改 CI 配置。
limit_en: Laravel test design and review only: no app code, no test runs, no CI edits. Pest/PHPUnit syntax is deferred to framework docs; without actual test.
title_en: Laravel test reviewer that asks if each assertion earns.
